fact: Thalamocortical synaptic dynamics allow LR neurons to calculate head rotation speed, even though their inputs only provide head direction information.
source_span: Observed thalamocortical synaptic dynamics enable computational models of LR neurons to compute the speed of head rotation , despite receiving head direction inputs that do not explicitly encode speed . We show that the synaptic dynamics of thalamic inputs allow for the robust encoding of angular speed by LR cell models , even though these inputs only explicitly contain information about head direction , not speed . source_span: Our results show that proteins involved in these basic ingredients combine together in the presence of inevitable stochasticity in gene expression , to control the coupled fluctuations of gene expression that give rise to a one-dimensional developmental pattern in this organism . The analysis brings out the different roles and specificity of inter-cellular communication proteins in setting spatial correlations , before and during development .

fact: The newly described pathway required the cullin component Cdc53/Cul1 but was independent of the other central SCF component Skp1.
source_span: Unexpectedly , this pathway required the cullin component Cdc53/Cul1 but was independent of the other central SCF component Skp1 . Importantly , this ubiquitylation pathway does not require Skp1 ( Skp1-independent Cul1-dependent ubiquitylation ) and suggests a function of Cdc53/Cul1 that is independent from association with Skp1 . The experiments with skp1 single and skp1 cdc53 double mutants strongly suggested that the ‘Skp1-free’ degradation pathway for Met30 was dependent on Cdc53 and independent of Skp1 .

fact: This non-canonical degradation pathway is critical for chromosome stability and effective defense against heavy metal stress in yeast.
source_span: We demonstrated that this non-canonical degradation pathway is critical for chromosome stability and effective defense against heavy metal stress . fact: The results assign important biological functions to a sub-complex of cullin-RING ligases comprising Cdc53/Rbx1/Cdc34, but independent of Skp1.
source_span: More importantly , our results assign important biological functions to a sub-complex of cullin-RING ligases that comprises Cdc53/Rbx1/Cdc34 , but is independent of Skp1 . This degradation pathway targets Met30 that is detached from Skp1 and involves the SCF core components Cdc53 and Rbx1 , as well as the cognate SCF ubiquitin conjugating enzyme Cdc34 . Together , our findings shed light on the regulation and complexity of E3 ligases and suggest additional diversity in the cullin-RING family of ubiquitin ligases .
